source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of a neuron (PDF 27-28).

blocks.text: Neurons ki banawat mein bohat farq hota hai, lekin har neuron ke teen bunyadi hisse hain: cell body, dendrites aur axon.

Cell body neuron ka phaila hua hissa hai. Neuron ka nucleus aur us ke zyada tar organelles cell body mein hote hain. Cell body ke cytoplasm ki pehchan Nissl's granules hain. Yeh ribosomes aur rough endoplasmic reticulum ke guchhe hain.

Dendrites cell body se nikalne wale, membrane mein lipte hue (membrane-bounded) phailao hain. Dendrites doosre neurons ya doosre cells se maloomat lete hain, use nerve impulses mein badalte hain aur cell body ki taraf le jate hain. Cell body se impulses axon ke zariye door le jaye jate hain. Motor aur inter-neurons ek hi waqt mein bohat si jagahon se impulses lete hain, isi liye un ke dendrites bohat zyada shakhdar (branched) hote hain.

blocks.alt: Neuron: shakhdar dendrites cell body ke gird jis mein nucleus hai, aur lamba axon jis par Schwann cells hain aur jo shakhdar axon terminals par khatam hota hai. Teer myelinated axon ki bari tasveer tak jata hai jo patle sire se mur kar neeche aata hai; oopar do Schwann cells ke darmiyan node of Ranvier hai, aur neeche daen taraf chaura kata hua sira myelin sheath (charbi ka ghilaf) ki tahein, Schwann cell ka nucleus aur bahar nikla axon dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.1: Namoone ke neuron ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 15.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Dendrites, Nucleus, Cell body, Axon, Schwann cell, Axon terminals; bari tasveer mein Node of Ranvier, Nucleus of Schwann cell, Myelin sheath, Axon.

blocks.text: Axon cell body ka lamba, membrane mein lipta hua phailao hai. Yeh impulses ko cell body se door le jata hai. Neuron mein ek axon bhi ho sakta hai aur shakhdar axons bhi. Axon ke sire ko axon terminal kehte hain. Yeh kisi muscle cell, gland cell ya doosre neuron se mil kar us tak paigham pohancha sakta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ko baayen se daayen parhein: shakhdar dendrites paigham lete hain, cell body (nucleus wala hissa) use sambhalti hai, aur lamba axon use aage axon terminals tak le jata hai. Bari tasveer mein dekhein ke Schwann cell axon ke gird lipat kar myelin sheath banata hai, aur do Schwann cells ke beech khaali jagah node of Ranvier hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Axon kaafi lamba ho sakta hai: aap ke paon ke muscles ko chalane wale axons ek meter se zyada lambe hain, aur zarafe (giraffe) mein khopri se pelvis tak jane wale axons taqreeban teen meter lambe hain!
